title: MEMA community resiliency hub network plan
summary: Maui Emergency Management Agency (MEMA) has picked a contractor to write a strategic plan for a community resiliency hub network, and the administrator said the plan should be done in two to three months. The network would connect nonprofits whose facilities and services can help with response and recovery. The request for proposals was delayed about a year by problems with procurement language.
